question: Can beings without fresh impressions still experience good and bad results elsewhere?
premises: Beings without new impressions may arise in Bharata and elsewhere.
Firm prior impressions persist in them.
The will of the Lord also operates in their experience.
inference: Even without forming new impressions, beings may undergo good and bad results due to firm prior impressions and the Lord's will.
plain_english: Even those without fresh impressions may appear in Bharata or elsewhere, and they still experience good and bad results through firm past impressions and by the will of the Lord.
